answer: The ember schedule is applied in island and tide publishes each instalment. A payout is split which means 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2839 identities would post 1456 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
